gen-gf-autour-one-gf-atkinson-hyperlegib: Chunky round headlines, drawn with no pen swell. Atkinson Hyperlegible Next follows with big, open lowercase eyes, so the loud heading hands off to text that stays easy to decode.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-montserrat-alternat: Rounded, loud, and unshaded up top. Montserrat Alternates brings a gaping c and lowercase that crowds the capital line, and that shift from heavy to light is what makes the pair work.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-syriac: Neon-tube lines, bold and showy: Autour One keeps every stroke uniform while the shapes stay round. Noto Sans Syriac then adds tall, bulb-like bowls to soften the handoff.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-serif-grantha: Refined, mostly: Noto Serif Grantha keeps modest stress in its curves and oversized-looking small letters. But Autour One's talent is pencil-like lines that never thicken or thin, loud where Grantha is measured.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-fs-karma: Expressive and flat-lined, Balsamiq Sans keeps a single weight and never pinches a curve. Karma is the opposite, a trustworthy text face with a gentle pencil-like taper and terminals that stop short of the stem.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-actor: Flat, chunky, and cheerfully loud from edge to edge. Balsamiq Sans does the single-weight shout best, while Actor handles the quieter work, with wide s curves barely curled in.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-sour-gummy: Loud, bold, and entirely free of calligraphic shading. Balsamiq Sans is at its best making a statement, while Sour Gummy, a modern sans, keeps tiny sizes crisp through wide gaps.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-spectral: Spectral draws its stems a touch heavier than its crossbars, with the gentle thinning of letters stamped in soft metal. But Balsamiq Sans is the better shouter, a monoline heading that never varies.
gen-gf-baumans-fs-rowan: Distinctive: Baumans draws a c like a crescent wrench opened wide. Rowan, a friendly serif, adds gentle variation in line weight inside each letter, so the uniform heading gets a softer follow-up.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-actor: Baumans builds every diagonal as stout as every upright. Actor, a sans-serif with wide s curves barely curled in, gives that sturdy heading a lighter, more modern partner on the page.
